requirements: Sellers create listings with a status and a price; prices are never negative. Every signed-in user sees active listings; sellers also see and edit their own listings whatever the status, but a listing keeps its id. Buyers place orders on listings and see only their own orders. Nothing is deleted. A seller may hand a listing over to another seller.
expected_properties: A listing is visible only when active or to its seller.
An order is visible only to its buyer.
Only the seller changes a listing.
Whatever is written can be read back.
The application role may only select/insert/update listings and select/insert orders.
Every signed-in user can read active listings.
A seller can read their own listings.
A seller can create a listing with a non-negative price.
A seller can reprice their listing.
A buyer can place an order in their own name.
A buyer can read their own orders.
